article.title: Basis擴展Compass，把媒體研究和投放紀錄帶進規劃
article.summary: Basis公布Compass新增第三方研究接入和跨渠道表現分析，亦開放部分功能供外部AI代理操作。
highlights: 研究接入首批支援Morning Consult，須使用客戶本身的憑證。
支援的外部代理可讀寫部分策略、規劃及投放功能。
article.why: 媒體團隊可把規劃參考資料集中整理，並把查詢與改動投放的權限分開。
article.next_step: 先用歷史活動做唯讀測試，逐項核對來源、轉換定義及可操作的帳戶範圍。
article.detail: Basis表示，Compass可把品牌以往的跨渠道表現帶入新計劃，並接入客戶已訂用的Morning Consult研究。Basis另透過模型情境協定（MCP）向外部AI工具提供部分讀寫功能。評估時可先核對歷史數據的歸因口徑，再決定哪些操作可以交給代理，哪些必須由人員批准。
article.title_en: Basis expands Compass to bring media research and campaign history into planning
article.summary_en: Basis announced third-party research and cross-channel performance capabilities in Compass, plus external AI agent access to selected features.
highlights_en: Morning Consult is an initial research partner, using customer credentials.
Supported external agents can read and write selected strategy, planning and activation features.
article.why_en: Media teams can consolidate planning inputs and separate lookup permissions from campaign changes.
article.next_step_en: Run a read-only test on a past campaign and check sources, conversion definitions and account scope.
article.detail_en: Basis says Compass can bring prior cross-channel performance into planning and connect to a customer's Morning Consult research. A Model Context Protocol, or MCP, server also gives external AI tools read and write access to selected features. Check the attribution basis of historical data before deciding which actions to delegate and which require human approval.
